description: 遊覽車營運狀況調查(Tourist Bus Business Survey) [public transit] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 交通部. 遊覽車之基本資料、行駛里程、保養及維修費用、營運狀況、配屬人員基本資料、公司基本資料、營運狀況與未來展望之意見。. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 交通部. Its tags are 交通及通訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-05-22 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
